title: Neo Hook Manifest
description: Schema for Neo plugin hook manifests at plugins/<plugin>/hooks/hooks.json. Event keys use the canonical Copilot CLI camelCase form; each event also has a PascalCase alias (SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, Stop, ...) that VS Code reads for the same event, mapping `bash` to osx/linux and `powershell` to windows. Declaring an event in both its camelCase and PascalCase form fires it twice and is rejected by scripts/validate-plugins.py. Note there is no lowercase `userPromptSubmit` or `stop` event — those are the PascalCase aliases mis-cased, and never fire.

version.description: Manifest schema version. Only version 1 is currently defined.

description.description: Short description of what the hooks in this manifest do.

hooks.description: Map of lifecycle event names to arrays of hook command entries.

type.description: Hook entry type. Only "command" is supported.

command.description: Cross-platform command. VS Code-native property. Do not use this property to invoke plugin scripts: one portable command cannot guard script existence in both POSIX shells and PowerShell. Use guarded bash and powershell properties instead.

bash.description: Copilot CLI property mapped to the osx and linux commands. Use ${PLUGIN_ROOT} to locate plugin scripts, guard the script's existence, and invoke it through an explicit interpreter (`s="${PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/scripts/x.sh"; [ -f "$s" ] || exit 0; bash "$s" event`). Running `"$s"` directly requires the POSIX executable bit, which the -f guard does not check and which zip/copy transports drop; exec then fails with 126, and on a fail-closed event that denies every tool call. A hook that exits non-zero is a failed hook.

powershell.description: Copilot CLI property mapped to the windows command. Use $env:PLUGIN_ROOT (NOT ${PLUGIN_ROOT}) to locate plugin scripts — ${PLUGIN_ROOT} is PowerShell's own variable syntax and expands to empty. Guard the script's existence, then invoke it through an explicit interpreter, never `& $s` (`$s = "$env:PLUGIN_ROOT/hooks/scripts/x.ps1"; if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $s)) { exit 0 }; pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "$s" event`). `& $s` runs a script FILE, which PowerShell execution policy governs, and the harness passes no -ExecutionPolicy flag; on a stock Windows client every scope is Undefined, resolving to Restricted, and the file refuses to load. -ExecutionPolicy Bypass is process-scoped and persists nothing. A hook that exits non-zero is a failed hook, and on a fail-closed event that denies the tool call.

windows.description: Windows-specific command override. VS Code-native property.

linux.description: Linux-specific command override. VS Code-native property.

osx.description: macOS-specific command override. VS Code-native property.

env.description: Additional environment variables for the command.

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds. VS Code-native property (default 30).

timeoutSec.description: Timeout in seconds. Copilot CLI property.
